task_completion.description: Open the 'Blobs (25K)' sample image in ImageJ.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'blobs.gif' or 'Blobs (25K)' image window is visible in the ImageJ workspace.

task_completion.description: Extract four distinct 64x64 pixel crops of different blobs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Four separate small image windows (patches) are visible, or a stack containing four 64x64 images is created. Each should contain a distinct blob.

task_completion.description: Combine the four patches into an image stack.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An ImageJ stack window is visible with a scroll bar at the bottom indicating 4 slices, or the 'Images to Stack' dialog is used.

task_completion.description: Configure the Make Montage dialog with 2 columns, 2 rows, scale 1.0, and 0 border width.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Make Montage' dialog box is shown with 'Columns: 2', 'Rows: 2', 'Scale factor: 1.0', and 'Border width: 0' entered.
A new image window titled 'Montage' appears showing a 2x2 grid of the previously extracted blobs.

task_completion.description: Save the final montage as a PNG to the specified results directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' file dialog is visible showing the path '~/ImageJ_Data/results/blobs_montage.png' or a successful save confirmation in the status bar.

integrity.description: The agent used the ImageJ GUI menus and tools rather than just executing shell commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with ImageJ menus (File, Image, Process) and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent manually selected or specified crop coordinates for distinct blobs.
integrity.visual_evidence: Selection boxes (ROIs) are visible on the original blobs image before the 'Duplicate' or 'Crop' command is used.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply move an existing file to the destination.
integrity.visual_evidence: The montage is seen being constructed step-by-step from the source image in the GUI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The final output must be a 128x128 pixel PNG image (calculated from a 2x2 grid of 64x64 patches). The montage must have 0 border width and a scale of 1.0. The expected file path is /home/ga/ImageJ_Data/results/blobs_montage.png. The source image is the standard ImageJ 'Blobs' sample.
